name: Deepentix
founders: Morteza Amini; Endri Deliu; Altan Nar
investors: tecnet equity; Rockstart; Kambis Kohansal Vajargah
grants: FFplus SAGE-AI project coordinated by Deepentix with TIB; project identifies EuroHPC Joint Undertaking funding under grant agreement 101163317, supported by the Digital Europe Programme. Company website also displays support from Austria Wirtschaftsservice, INiTS, NVIDIA Inception, AWS Startups and Google Cloud for Startups; individual awards and amounts are not disclosed.
awards: Startup World Cup Austria 2026 finalist; third place at Unicorn Battle Silicon Valley, October 12, 2026, according to an organizer announcement reproduced publicly on LinkedIn.
one_line: Enterprise AI platform that turns regulated documents into auditable knowledge graphs and domain-specific small-language-model workflows deployable on customer infrastructure.
red_flags: Legal entity is Deepentix FlexCo; registered seat is Oberwaltersdorf, while LinkedIn and Dealroom describe Vienna as headquarters. Six-figure SAFE pre-seed financing was announced August 20, 2026; the investor portfolio separately gives April 2026 as investment date. Exact amount is undisclosed, so the supplied funding taxonomy cannot distinguish PRESEED_LE_500K from INSTITUTIONAL_GT_500K and funding_status is UNKNOWN, not an absence of funding. Product_live=0 means no public self-service signup, purchase or instant trial was verified; demos and negotiated enterprise deployments are offered. Supporter and media logos are not counted as customers. An indexed technical-cofounder vacancy refers to the earlier SciPub+ product and was not accepted as a current opening. A founder describes himself as a PhD researcher, which does not verify a completed doctorate. Press count is a minimum of nine identified external articles within November 21, 2025–November 21, 2026, excluding the investor's own announcement; it is not exhaustive. No verified trademark or patent filing found.
